versions.changelog:
Version 1.1.0

- Updated skill description and instructions in SKILL.md for clearer guidance.
- Mandatory $0/free LLC and business-formation offer warning must now be displayed to users before intake begins.
- Expanded and clarified the intake procedure; step-by-step checklist, live fee quoting, validation, and handoff instructions refined.
- Added exact language and requirements for user-facing pricing and recurring service explanations.
- Clarified tool compatibility (MCP upgrade vs. HTTP fallback) and emphasized never quoting fees from memory.
- Additional guidance about when and how to use industry code (NAICS) lookups and handoff links.
